description: Derived product-to-mechanism relationships generated from product-bioactives.json x bioactive-mechanisms.json and product-nutrients.json x nutrient-mechanisms.json. This file is DERIVED, not hand-curated: it must be regenerated whenever product-bioactives.json, product-nutrients.json, bioactive-mechanisms.json or nutrient-mechanisms.json change. Each relationship's top-level strength/confidence reflect its single strongest contributing bioactive or nutrient path; 'contributors' preserves every path so the recommendation stays auditable back to the active ingredient. Confidence is discounted for SOURCE_DEFINED contributors relative to DIRECT ones.
generationRule: All DIRECT and SOURCE_DEFINED bioactives (via bioactive-mechanisms.json) plus all DIRECT and SOURCE_DEFINED vitamins/minerals (via nutrient-mechanisms.json)
